1: // Simple endless vertical scrolling game "Sky Diver"
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 400;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // Player (parachuter)
11:   const player = { x: width / 2, y: height - 50, w: 30, h: 30, speed: 4 };
12: 
13:   // Game objects
14:   const obstacles = [];
15:   const coins = [];
16:   let score = 0;
17:   let gameOver = false;
18: 
19:   // Input handling
20:   // Audio setup
21:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
22:   function playSound(freq, type = 'sine', duration = 0.1) {
23:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
24:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
25:     oscillator.type = type;
26:     oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
27:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
28:     oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
29:     oscillator.start();
30:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
31:   }
32:   function playCoinSound() { playSound(800, 'triangle', 0.08); }
33:   function playCollisionSound() { playSound(200, 'sawtooth', 0.3); }
34: 
35:   const keys = {};
36:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.key] = true);
37:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
38: 
39:   function spawnObstacle() {
40:     const size = 30 + Math.random() * 20;
41:     obstacles.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2 });
42:   }
43:   function spawnCoin() {
44:     const size = 15;
45:     coins.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, r: size / 2, speed: 2 });
46:   }
47: 
48:   let obstacleTimer = 0, coinTimer = 0;
49: 
50:   function update() {
51:     if (gameOver) return;
52:     // Player movement
53:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) player.x -= player.speed;
54:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) player.x += player.speed;
55:     // Clamp
56:     if (player.x < 0) player.x = 0;
57:     if (player.x + player.w > width) player.x = width - player.w;
58: 
59:     // Spawn obstacles/coins
60:     obstacleTimer++;
61:     coinTimer++;
62:     if (obstacleTimer > 90) { spawnObstacle(); obstacleTimer = 0; }
63:     if (coinTimer > 150) { spawnCoin(); coinTimer = 0; }
64: 
65:     // Move obstacles
66:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
67:       const o = obstacles[i];
68:       o.y += o.speed;
69:       if (o.y > height) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
70:       // Collision with player
71:       if (rectIntersect(player, o)) { playCollisionSound(); gameOver = true; }
72:     }
73:     // Move coins
74:     for (let i = coins.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
75:       const c = coins[i];
76:       c.y += c.speed;
77:       if (c.y > height) { coins.splice(i, 1); continue; }
78:       if (circleRectIntersect(c, player)) { playCoinSound(); score++; coins.splice(i, 1); }
79:     }
80:   }
81: 
82: function draw() {
83:     // Sky background gradient
84:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
85:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#87ceeb'); // light sky
86:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#1e90ff'); // deeper
87:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
88:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
89: 
90:     // Simple moving clouds (light white ellipses)
91:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
92:     for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
93:       const cx = (i * 150 + (Date.now() / 30) % width) % width;
94:       ctx.beginPath();
95:       ctx.ellipse(cx, 80 + i * 30, 60, 30, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
96:       ctx.fill();
97:     }
98: 
99:     // Player (parachuter with canopy) – already drawn in its own code block
100:     // (drawn earlier in draw function)
101:     // Redraw player here using existing logic
102:     // Player (parachuter with canopy)
103:     // Draw parachute canopy
104:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
105:     ctx.beginPath();
106:     ctx.arc(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y, player.w, Math.PI, 2 * Math.PI);
107:     ctx.fill();
108:     // Draw cords
109:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#000';
110:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
111:     ctx.beginPath();
112:     ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y + player.h);
113:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y);
114:     ctx.moveTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h);
115:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y);
116:     ctx.stroke();
117:     // Draw body
118:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
119:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y + player.h / 2, player.w, player.h / 2);
120: 
121:     // Obstacles – birds (red triangles) and balloons (blue circles)
122:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
123:       if (o.w > 40) {
124:         // Balloon
125:         ctx.fillStyle = '#00aaff';
126:         ctx.beginPath();
127:         ctx.arc(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y + o.h / 2, o.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
128:         ctx.fill();
129:         // String
130:         ctx.strokeStyle = '#555';
131:         ctx.beginPath();
132:         ctx.moveTo(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y + o.h / 2);
133:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y + o.h + 10);
134:         ctx.stroke();
135:       } else {
136:         // Bird – simple triangle
137:         ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
138:         ctx.beginPath();
139:         ctx.moveTo(o.x, o.y + o.h);
140:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y);
141:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w, o.y + o.h);
142:         ctx.closePath();
143:         ctx.fill();
144:       }
145:     });
146: 
147:     // Coins – gold radial gradient
148:     coins.forEach(c => {
149:       const radGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(c.x + c.r, c.y + c.r, c.r * 0.2, c.x + c.r, c.y + c.r, c.r);
150:       radGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ffd700');
151:       radGrad.addColorStop(1, '#ff8c00');
152:       ctx.fillStyle = radGrad;
153:       ctx.beginPath();
154:       ctx.arc(c.x + c.r, c.y + c.r, c.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
155:       ctx.fill();
156:     });
157: 
158:     // Score
159:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
160:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
161:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
162:     if (gameOver) {
163:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
164:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
165:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
166:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
167:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 80, height / 2);
168:     }
169:   }
170:   }
171: 
172:   function loop() {
173:     update();
174:     draw();
175:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
176:   }
177:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
178: 
179:   // Helper collision functions
180:   function rectIntersect(a, b) {
181:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
182:   }
183:   function circleRectIntersect(c, r) {
184:     const distX = Math.abs(c.x + c.r - (r.x + r.w / 2));
185:     const distY = Math.abs(c.y + c.r - (r.y + r.h / 2));
186:     if (distX > (r.w / 2 + c.r)) return false;
187:     if (distY > (r.h / 2 + c.r)) return false;
188:     if (distX <= (r.w / 2)) return true;
189:     if (distY <= (r.h / 2)) return true;
190:     const dx = distX - r.w / 2;
191:     const dy = distY - r.h / 2;
192:     return (dx * dx + dy * dy <= (c.r * c.r));
193:   }
194: })();
